scope: One instrumented diagnostic, not acceptance. Numeric timestamps share the same document performance clock. Interval overlap shows co-occurrence, not independent causal attribution; frame totals may repeat across related events. Native method durations exclude accounting after the return and never include additional geometry calls.
limitations: LoAF threshold50ms and EventTiming threshold16ms censor shorter work.
Observer delivery can exclude an unfinished final frame; buffered records are drained without adding an extra wait or modifying original actions.
Instrumentation adds overhead, and repeated overlaps must not be summed as total CPU cost.
No text values, account identifiers, private URLs, source text or credentials are collected.
